sloka: नये युद्धे च कुशलः सर्व शास्त्रभृताम् वरः ।अमर्षी दुर्जयो जेता विक्रान्तो बुद्धिमान् बली ॥६-२८-२४॥।।
transliteration: naye yuddhe ca kuśalaḥ sarva śāstrabhṛtām varaḥ ।amarṣī durjayo jetā vikrānto buddhimān balī ॥6-28-24॥।।

translations.english: "He is one who does not forgive (Rama's enemies), difficult to win, indomitable, victorious, strong and wise one. He is the right hand of Rama and external breath of his life."
